title: Delete repetition
rule: Delete repetition that adds no information. Nothing in a single slide should be filler for things that have already been said, especially titles and visual metadata.
example: The result appears once, where the argument needs it.
counterexample: Repeat the result in the slide title, subtitle, chart label, and closing sentence.
rationale: Repetition uses attention without adding information.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
